item.title: New Bus and Cycle Shelters Roll Out Across Orkney
item.description: New bus and cycle shelters are being installed across Orkney following Scottish Government funding, with upgrades designed to support public transport use, improve real time travel information, and encourage active travel in communities across the islands.The post New Bus and Cycle Shelters Roll Out Across Orkney appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Royal National Mòd Delivers £3.9m Economic Boost for Lochaber
item.description: The Royal National Mòd 2025 delivered a £3.9 million economic boost for Lochaber, supporting jobs, local businesses, and Gaelic culture, with new research highlighting the festival’s lasting social, cultural, and economic impact across the region.The post Royal National Mòd Delivers £3.9m Economic Boost for Lochaber appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Questions Mount Over Scottish Labour Campaign as Sarwar Faces Fresh Scrutiny
item.description: Scottish Labour is facing mounting scrutiny after a series of campaign controversies involving fabricated quotes and unauthorised images, with Anas Sarwar now reported to the Electoral Commission as questions grow over trust, consent, and campaign standards.The post Questions Mount Over Scottish Labour Campaign as Sarwar Faces Fresh Scrutiny appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Well Kept Village Home Framed by Mountains in Kinlochleven
item.description: Set in the heart of Kinlochleven, this well presented two bedroom home offers mountain views, practical living space, and a strong village setting, making it an ideal choice for buyers seeking a balanced Highland lifestyle.The post A Well Kept Village Home Framed by Mountains in Kinlochleven appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Parklands Announces Multi Million Pound Investment in Care Across The North
item.description: Parklands Care Homes has announced a multi million pound investment in care provision across the north and north east of Scotland, including a new 60 bed care home in Turriff and major expansions to existing homes in Highland and Moray.The post Parklands Announces Multi Million Pound Investment in Care Across The North appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ardvreck Castle Parking Improvement Works Get Underway
item.description: Parking improvement works are getting underway at Ardvreck Castle in Sutherland, with Highland Council investing in safer access, improved facilities, and sustainable tourism infrastructure at one of the North Coast 500’s most visited historic sites.The post Ardvreck Castle Parking Improvement Works Get Underway appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Greens Warn Scotland Must Stand Up Against Trump
item.description: Scottish Greens warn Scotland must take a clear stand against Donald Trump’s threats towards Greenland, urging the First Minister to rule out the use of Scottish assets and to defend international law, climate responsibility, and democratic values.The post Greens Warn Scotland Must Stand Up Against Trump appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Postal Voters Urged to Reapply or Risk Losing Their Vote
item.description: Postal voters across the Highlands and Western Isles are being urged to reapply by 31 January 2026 under new UK election rules, with officials warning that anyone who fails to act will lose their postal vote for future UK Parliamentary elections.The post Postal Voters Urged to Reapply or Risk Losing Their Vote appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Its Got The Wow Factor as Skoda Elroq Continues Award Winning Run
item.description: The Skoda Elroq has continued its award winning streak after being named Car of the Year 2026 by Company Car and Van, with judges praising its value, practicality, and broad appeal across private buyers and fleet drivers alike.The post Its Got The Wow Factor as Skoda Elroq Continues Award Winning Run appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Developer Inaction Just Not Good Enough Says Angry Labour Councillor
item.description: an Inverness Labour councillor has condemned the worsening condition of the former Fairfield Care Home site, warning that developer inaction is damaging local amenity and urging urgent cooperation with the council to secure a safe and acceptable future for the buildings.The post Developer Inaction Just Not Good Enough Says Angry Labour Councillor appeared first on The Highland Times.
